\definecolor{brandink}{HTML}{16181D}
\definecolor{brandblue}{HTML}{3C6BF0}
\definecolor{muted}{HTML}{5B6069}
\definecolor{line}{HTML}{D9D9D2}
\definecolor{link}{HTML}{2A55D6}
\definecolor{soft}{HTML}{E6ECFD}
\definecolor{shadecolor}{HTML}{F4F4F0}
\tracinglostchars=3
\AtBeginDocument{\hypersetup{linkcolor=link, urlcolor=link, citecolor=link, filecolor=link}}

\newfontfamily\displayfont{Inter Display}[Numbers=Lining]

\setkomafont{disposition}{\displayfont\bfseries\color{brandink}}
\setkomafont{chapter}{\fontsize{26}{31}\selectfont}
\setkomafont{section}{\fontsize{14.5}{19}\selectfont}
\setkomafont{subsection}{\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont}
\setkomafont{subsubsection}{\normalsize}
\setkomafont{part}{\fontsize{34}{40}\selectfont}
\setkomafont{partnumber}{}
\setkomafont{chapterentry}{\displayfont\bfseries}
\setkomafont{pageheadfoot}{\footnotesize\color{muted}}
\setkomafont{pagenumber}{\footnotesize\color{muted}}
\setkomafont{caption}{\small\color{muted}}
\setkomafont{captionlabel}{\small\bfseries\color{brandink}}
\setkomafont{descriptionlabel}{\bfseries}

\renewcommand*{\chapterformat}{\textcolor{brandblue}{\thechapter}\hspace{0.45em}}
\renewcommand*{\sectionformat}{\textcolor{brandblue}{\thesection}\hspace{0.6em}}
\renewcommand*{\subsectionformat}{\textcolor{brandblue}{\thesubsection}\hspace{0.6em}}
\renewcommand*{\partformat}{{\normalsize\mdseries\color{brandblue}\addfontfeature{LetterSpace=8}\MakeUppercase{\partname~\thepart}}}
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=0pt, afterskip=28pt]{chapter}
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=-26pt plus -4pt, afterskip=10pt]{section}
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=-18pt plus -3pt, afterskip=6pt]{subsection}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{0}
\clubpenalty=10000
\widowpenalty=10000
\usepackage{needspace}
\newcommand{\biyosroom}[1]{\needspace{8\baselineskip}}
\AddtoDoHook{heading/preinit/section}{\biyosroom}

\usepackage{scrlayer-scrpage}
\clearpairofpagestyles
\automark[chapter]{chapter}
\ohead{\pagemark}
\ihead{\headmark}
\setlength{\footheight}{14pt}

\usepackage[skins,breakable]{tcolorbox}
\usepackage{fvextra}
\fvset{breaklines=true, breakanywhere=true, breaknonspaceingroup=true, breaksymbolleft={\color{muted}\tiny\ensuremath{\hookrightarrow}}, backgroundcolorboxoverlap=0pt}
\RecustomVerbatimEnvironment{verbatim}{Verbatim}{}
\renewenvironment{Shaded}{\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable, enhanced, frame hidden, sharp corners, colback=shadecolor, boxsep=0pt, left=6pt, right=6pt, top=5pt, bottom=5pt, before skip=6pt, after skip=8pt]\small}{\end{tcolorbox}}
\definecolor{sigtint}{HTML}{EEF2FD}
\newenvironment{biyossignature}{\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable, enhanced, frame hidden, sharp corners, colback=sigtint, borderline west={2pt}{0pt}{brandblue}, boxsep=0pt, left=8pt, right=6pt, top=5pt, bottom=5pt, before skip=6pt, after skip=8pt]\small}{\end{tcolorbox}}
\newcommand{\biyosfilename}[1]{\par\noindent{\footnotesize\color{muted}#1}\par\nopagebreak[4]\vspace{-4pt}}
\AtBeginDocument{\renewenvironment{codelisting}{\par\begingroup\let\caption\biyosfilename}{\endgroup\par}}
\newtcolorbox{biyosnote}[1]{enhanced, unbreakable, frame hidden, sharp corners, colback=soft, borderline west={2pt}{0pt}{brandblue}, left=10pt, right=10pt, top=6pt, bottom=6pt, before skip=10pt, after skip=10pt, fonttitle=\small\bfseries\color{brandink}, coltitle=brandink, colbacktitle=soft, title={#1}, attach title to upper, after title={\par\smallskip}}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand{\maketitle}{%
  \begin{titlepage}
    \vspace*{38mm}
    \includegraphics[width=68mm]{logo/lockup.pdf}\par
    \vspace{20mm}
    {\displayfont\bfseries\fontsize{22}{28}\selectfont\color{brandink}\@subtitle\par}
    \vspace{6mm}
    {\large\color{muted}User guide, method and reference\par}
    \vfill
    {\color{brandblue}\rule{18mm}{2.5pt}}\par
  \end{titlepage}}
\makeatother

\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.25}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\biyosragged}{\rightskip=0pt plus 3em\relax\@rightskip=\rightskip\parfillskip=0pt plus 1fil\relax}
\AtBeginEnvironment{CSLReferences}{\@rightskip=\@flushglue}
\makeatother
\AtBeginDocument{\biyosragged\lefthyphenmin=64\righthyphenmin=64\renewcommand{\markright}[1]{}}
\AtBeginDocument{\DeclareCaptionJustification{biyos}{\biyosragged}\captionsetup{justification=biyos, singlelinecheck=false}}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand*{\@pnumwidth}{2.4em}
\makeatother
\DeclareRobustCommand{\_}{\textunderscore\allowbreak}
\AtBeginDocument{\pdfstringdefDisableCommands{\def\_{\textunderscore}}}
\AtBeginDocument{\urlstyle{same}}
\setlength{\LTleft}{0pt}
\setlength{\LTright}{\fill}

\usepackage{colortbl}
\definecolor{rowrule}{HTML}{E4E4DE}
\definecolor{headrule}{HTML}{C9CCD4}
\definecolor{headtint}{HTML}{EEF2FD}
\newlength{\biyostmp}
\newlength{\biyosrest}
\newlength{\biyoswA}
\newlength{\biyoswB}
\newlength{\biyoswC}
\newlength{\biyoswD}
\newlength{\biyoswE}
\newlength{\biyoswF}
\newcommand{\biyosreset}{\setlength{\biyoswA}{0pt}\setlength{\biyoswB}{0pt}\setlength{\biyoswC}{0pt}\setlength{\biyoswD}{0pt}\setlength{\biyoswE}{0pt}\setlength{\biyoswF}{0pt}}
\newcommand{\biyoswiden}[2]{\settowidth{\biyostmp}{#2}\ifdim\biyostmp>#1\setlength{#1}{\biyostmp}\fi}
\newcommand{\biyoscap}[1]{\ifdim#1>0.42\linewidth\setlength{#1}{0.42\linewidth}\fi}
\makeatletter
\catcode`\_=11 \catcode`\:=11
\patchcmd{\endlongtable}{\endgraf\penalty\z@}{\endgraf\nobreak}{}{\errmessage{cannot keep a longtable with what follows}}
\catcode`\_=8 \catcode`\:=12
\makeatother
\newcommand{\biyostablesetup}{\small\setlength{\tabcolsep}{6pt}\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}}
\newenvironment{biyostable}{\par\begingroup\biyostablesetup\setlength{\LTpre}{6pt}\setlength{\LTpost}{10pt}}{\endgroup\par}
\newenvironment{biyoskept}{\par\penalty0\vspace{6pt}\begingroup\biyostablesetup\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}{\endgroup\par\nobreak\vspace{10pt}}
\newcommand{\biyoslabel}[1]{{\scriptsize\bfseries\color{muted}\addfontfeatures{LetterSpace=6}\MakeUppercase{#1}}}
\newcommand{\biyoshead}[1]{\biyoslabel{#1}}
\newcommand{\biyossince}[1]{\hfill{\footnotesize\normalfont\color{muted}#1}}
\newcommand{\biyoscaption}[1]{\biyoslabel{#1}\rule[-6pt]{0pt}{6pt}}
\newcommand{\biyosheadrow}{\biyosheadrule\rowcolor{headtint}}
\newcommand{\biyosheadrule}{\arrayrulecolor{headrule}\specialrule{0.6pt}{0pt}{0pt}}
\newcommand{\biyosrule}{\arrayrulecolor{rowrule}\specialrule{0.4pt}{0pt}{0pt}}
\newcommand{\biyosbottomrule}{\arrayrulecolor{headrule}\specialrule{0.6pt}{0pt}{0pt}}
\newcommand{\biyosname}[1]{{\color{link}\bfseries #1}}
\newcommand{\biyostype}[1]{{\color{muted}\ttfamily\footnotesize #1}}
\newcommand{\biyosvalue}[1]{{\color{muted}\ttfamily #1}}
\newcommand{\biyosunbroken}[1]{\mbox{#1}}
\newcommand{\biyosdir}[1]{\enspace{\footnotesize\normalfont\color{muted}#1}}
\newenvironment{biyosmeta}{\par\nopagebreak\footnotesize}{\par}
\newcommand{\biyosalso}[1]{\par#1}
